content.description: Human-readable narrative label, e.g. "<name>: $X across N contracts (3yr)".

contract_count_3yr.description: Count of distinct contracts (by `ocid`, else fact id) with an award in the window.

contractor_abn.description: The CONTRACTOR_ABN axis: the contractor identity the rollup is keyed and superseded on. A real ABN where the publisher supplied one, otherwise a minted `demiton-c-<sha16>` name key.

contractor_entity_id.description: The civil-pipeline spine identity the rollup belongs to; also the producer's in-memory aggregation key.

derived_from_fact_count.description: Number of award facts scanned to produce the row; provenance for the rollup.

last_win_date.description: Date of the most recent award in the window.

observed_at.description: Run time at which the rollup was computed; drives freshness ordering.

state_primary.description: The single most frequent state among the window's awards. Same entity/fact split as `states_active`.

states_active.description: States the contractor's awards in the window belong to. Written to `PlatformEntity.attributes` today, not to the fact.

top_agency_names.description: Up to 5 buyer names with the most awards in the window.

top_unspsc_codes.description: Up to 5 category codes with the most awards in the window.

total_awarded_aud_3yr.description: Sum, across the distinct contracts in the window, of each contract's latest observed award value.

value_basis.description: What kind of money the measure is: awarded contract value, latest revision per contract — not a sum of award facts.

window_end.description: Last day of the window (= the run date, `observed_at`).

window_start.description: First day of the rolling window the totals cover.
